Components of an EquityTool object

Source: R/tool.R
et_accessors.Rd

Accessors for the pieces of an equitytool object created by et_parse_workbook().

Usage

et_vars(tool)

et_questions(tool)

et_scores(tool)

et_cutoffs(tool)

et_scopes(tool)

et_checks(tool)

Arguments

tool

An equitytool object.

Value

  • et_vars() a character vector of the question variable names ("Q1", ...) in question order.

  • et_questions() a data frame of question text and response option labels.

  • et_scores() a data frame with columns var, scope, option, score.

  • et_cutoffs() a data frame of quintile lower bounds by scope.

  • et_scopes() the scopes for which this tool can assign published quintiles.

  • et_checks() the result of cross-checking the syntax tab against the Other software tab, including any mismatching scores.

Examples

tool <- et_parse_workbook(et_example())
et_vars(tool)
#> [1] "Q1" "Q2" "Q3" "Q4" "Q5" "Q6" "Q7" "Q8"
head(et_questions(tool))
#>   var                                 question option label
#> 1  Q1 Does your household have... electricity?      1   Yes
#> 2  Q1 Does your household have... electricity?      2    No
#> 3  Q2                      ... a refrigerator?      1   Yes
#> 4  Q2                      ... a refrigerator?      2    No
#> 5  Q3                        ... a television?      1   Yes
#> 6  Q3                        ... a television?      2    No
et_scopes(tool)
#> [1] "national" "urban"   
et_checks(tool)$mismatches
#> [1] var       scope     option    syntax    other_tab
#> <0 rows> (or 0-length row.names)
